blocks.label: Content block 10
blocks.value: To be precise, moths don’t bite or cause any direct harm to human settlements. But like other pests, they can inflict widespread damage on your personal items. Moreover, infestation of moths can adversely affect your family’s health. Here are some of the common dangers associated with specific types of moths.

items: There are particular species of moths that can attack carpets and cloths. People wearing and using such things may experience severe allergies.
The hairs of the moths when they are caterpillars can trigger asthma.
Brown colored house moths typically feast on cereals and food products and can harm your health.
Moth droppings can contaminate your food.
Moths can make your life more stressful.
